text:
marta: Hey — after the otel-js 1.2.0 bump last night I'm seeing a bunch of background-job traces that stop at the worker process handoff (no child spans after the queue consumer). Anyone seen this or know where to start?

alex: I noticed similar on staging this morning. Can you paste a trace link or trace id?

marta: Trace link: https://honeycomb.io/trace/0xabc123/example (sample trace id 0xabc123). Grafana panel for job latency + traces: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/xyz/jobs-traces. Logs query I ran in Loki: `{job="bg-worker"} |= "processing" | json | trace_id="0xabc123"` — no child spans correlating in traces.

observability-bot: Alert: background-job-span-drop rate 3.1x across prod (see incident runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/obs/runbooks/span-drop).

pradeep: Two quick things to check: 1) sampler config and whether the SDK upgrade changed default sampling, 2) async context propagation (Node's async_hooks vs zone). If the child spans are never created it can be context loss on handoff.

pradeep: Example sampler override to try (temporary) — add to your TracerProvider init and redeploy the worker:

```
const provider = new NodeTracerProvider({
  sampler: new ParentBasedSampler({ root: new AlwaysOnSampler() })
});
provider.register();
```

alex: Good call. Also check the instrumentations list — if the queue lib instrumentation wasn't re-registered after the upgrade it won't create child spans. Try forcing re-init in the worker startup.

marta: Re-initialized instrumentation and redeployed to staging with the ParentBased+AlwaysOn sampler. Staging traces now show the child spans again for the same workload. Pushing a quick patch to prod canary.

lina: Nice. Can you also add a dashboard panel for "spans per trace" broken down by service? Would help catch regressions earlier. I can add a Grafana alert if that metric drops below baseline.

marta: Will add the panel and a short PR: github.com/redwood-inference/realtime/pull/834 (WIP). Also adding a small smoke check in CI that runs a local queue job and asserts span count >= 3.

alex: For troubleshooting in future: run this Loki query to confirm log-to-trace correlation: `{job="bg-worker"} | json | traceparent` — if traceparent header is missing at the handoff, that's the place to instrument.

pradeep: If anyone hits it again and needs a quick rollback: revert to otel-js 1.1.x (we pinned that in the last commit) while we dig. Also filing a small issue to investigate default sampler change post-upgrade.

marta: Thanks all — canary looks healthy after the sampler override. Leaving a follow-up ticket with links and steps: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-4521. :thumbsup:

lina: :eyes: ping me once PR is ready and I'll add the alert rule.

marta: will do — thanks!
